detail.title: Robustness of Physical Records and Observer Agreement
detail.summary: This cycle focuses on refining operational definitions of observer agreement within quantum Darwinism frameworks, prioritizing robust record formation under environmental noise.

children.title: quantitative operational metrics for observer agreement in quantum Darwinism environments

detail.reason: Establishing explicit metrics is necessary to distinguish between simple decoherence and true observer-independent record formation.

children.title: conditions where environmental redundancy fails to guarantee consistent observer agreement

detail.reason: Identifying counterexamples is crucial to mapping the limits of redundancy-based objective reality.
